name: Joonas Rotko
aboutParagraphs: Joonas Rotko runs thatmarketingbuddy.com, where he scores marketing software on AI-stack fit: MCP support, API quality, and how well a tool slots into agent workflows. Previously, co-owner of a Google Premier Partner agency for over ten years.
In this catalog, Joonas contributed B2B demo request qualifier, a WhatsApp flow for the demo requests that arrive from paid ads.
